# Words Defined

> A comprehensive word definition and etymology reference resource for English vocabulary with multilingual linguistic analysis.

Words Defined provides detailed definitions, etymologies, and usage examples for English words, tracing their origins through Latin, Greek, Old French, and Old Norse roots. The site serves as both a browsable dictionary index and a reference tool for understanding word origins and linguistic connections.
